column1: # MISCOMPILE class found by the variation sweep (WS3 bootstrap, 2026-07-13):
# a compiled `do [...]` closure unit whose body contains a registry-mutating
# statement REPLAYS it against the check pass's surviving state. A capitalised
# (type) def re-installs and hits "conflicts with an existing type name" at VM
# time (the interpreter installs once and returns the body value); the mirror
# half — a check-time registration (ParseLang.register, MiniLang) — is
# INVISIBLE to the compiled run ("no parser registered"). Value defs
# (`do [def b 5 ...]`) are unaffected. These rows COMPILE and fail PARITY —
# the ledger pins the divergence mode; graduation = the do-unit's
